t: A RISC-V Linux computer with an AI helper chip for curious tinkerers.
steps: Order a LicheePi 4A from the Sipeed store on AliExpress.
Get a 5 volt USB-C power supply rated for at least 2 amps.
Read the unboxing page on the Sipeed wiki.
Check the U-Boot version for your memory size and reflash it if the wiki says to.
Flash RevyOS to a microSD card or the built-in storage.
Connect a screen, keyboard, and network cable and boot the desktop.
Install Adafruit Blinka and blink an LED from Python.
meta: Open Board. From $179. A few stores.
